basis: Perinatal lysosomal storage disease with defining severe neonatal hepatic disease; direct pulmonary injury in >=30% is not established; neurologic disease may not emerge before early death.

decisions.hepatic: primary: severe neonatal hepatic disease defines this perinatal phenotype.
decisions.pulmonary: none: pulmonary infiltration can occur, but direct pulmonary injury in >=30% is not established; respiratory distress alone is insufficient.

basis: HHV-6/7 infection; the brief, self-limited exanthem is a transient rash without lasting skin damage. Neurologic injury is uncommon.

decisions.dermatologic: none: the characteristic rash is transient and does not establish lasting cutaneous damage.

basis: Syndromic developmental disability with defining skeletal anomalies, including contractures; strabismus and bilateral ptosis each occur in 30-79%. Feeding difficulty alone does not establish GI damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: skeletal anomalies, including kyphosis/scoliosis and arthrogryposis, are explicitly defining features; arthrogryposis is also reported in 2/2 assessed patients.

basis: Defining laryngotracheoesophageal malformations and urethral hypospadias; developmental delay occurs in 19/37 (~51%), with cerebellar vermis hypoplasia in 3/7.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: esophageal malformations form part of the defining laryngotracheoesophageal defects; dysphagia in 6/7 supports functional involvement.

basis: Inherited cholestatic liver disease with fibrosis in 4/4; hearing impairment occurs in 2/3. Hypocalcemia may be secondary to cholestasis; splenomegaly alone does not establish splenic dysfunction.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: USP53-related cholestasis is a hepatobiliary structural/transport disorder; inheritance and secondary hypocalcemia do not establish an intrinsic metabolic or endocrine disease.

basis: Organ-specific hereditary colorectal neoplasia susceptibility defines a gastrointestinal target; this does not establish an existing tumor or secondary organ damage.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: this hereditary neoplastic syndrome is defined by its colorectal target; no_axis is reserved for concepts whose organ systems fall outside the listed axes.

basis: Congenital secretory diarrhea; hepatic steatosis with elevated transaminases occurs in 5/5. Hypoglycemia also occurs in 5/5, but intrinsic metabolic/endocrine pathology is not established.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: recurrent hypoglycemia occurs in 5/5 but may follow enteropathy and nutritional depletion; frequency alone does not establish direct metabolic/endocrine disease.

basis: Multiple liver cysts define the disease; multiple renal cysts occur in 30-79% and represent direct structural renal involvement, even when filtration remains preserved.

decisions.renal: involved: HPO reports multiple renal cysts in 30-79%; cystic occupation is direct structural involvement and does not require established renal failure.

basis: Inflammation directly affects the iris; the generic concept does not establish an infectious or immune-mediated etiology.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: iris inflammation alone does not establish infection or immune-mediated disease; the generic concept also includes traumatic and etiologically unspecified forms.

basis: Malignant mesenchymal soft-tissue neoplasm in the solitary fibrous tumor spectrum; its vascular pattern does not establish vascular-wall origin. No specific visceral or CNS site is supplied.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: prominent branching vessels and historical pericytic terminology do not establish a cardiovascular tumor origin.
decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: this is a mesenchymal soft-tissue tumor in the solitary fibrous tumor spectrum, without a specified visceral or CNS origin.
